messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: - Tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to tirzepatide, any other medications, or any of the ingredients in this medicine. There is a list of ingredients in this medicine, at the bottom of this page.
- Tell your healthcare team if you are planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation.
- Tell your doctor if you have or have ever had kidney or pancreas disease, a history of diabetic retinopathy or any stomach problems such as difficulty digesting food.
- Tell your doctor if you plan to become pregnant, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding. If you become pregnant while taking this medicine, you should tell your doctor. There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who take Zepbound during pregnancy. Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part, call 1-844-524-0039, or visit https://pregnancyregistry.lilly.com/zepbound.
Triplet: ["Tirzepatide", "requires disclosure to doctor", "pregnancy or breastfeeding"]

The relation 'requires disclosure to doctor' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients using the subject medication must inform their doctor about the specified medical history or condition.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires patient to read': The patient is required to review the specified educational materials or documentation related to the medication.
C. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
D. 'requires use of': The subject drug requires patients to use the specified product or practice to ensure safety or effectiveness.
E. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
